title: CENETON: Census of Dutch plays, 1500-1803
authors: dr A.J.E. Harmsen, Universiteit Leiden, Onderwijsinstituut NDD
descriptions: The CENETON database includes detailed descriptions of all Dutch manuscripts and editions of Dutch plays, published until 1803. The database also contains translated works and plays written in foreign languages. Bibliographical data on Dutch plays are included comprising the full title of a play, original author, place of publishing, genre and a list of used persons. The signatures of (public) libraries are included to make it possible to locate a play.
